events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, was born on October 27, 1939.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the iconic John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his unique brand of British comedy has left an indelible mark.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles released their iconic double album, simply known as 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that pushed boundaries.

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: November 24th marks the 35th anniversary of the death of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Freddie Mercury Tribute
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the incomparable Freddie Mercury. His voice, stage presence, and legacy continue to inspire. We're celebrating the life of a true rock icon.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Album Anniversary
angles.copy: A pivotal moment in music history! Today marks 61 years since The Beatles unveiled 'Rubber Soul', an album that showcased their incredible songwriting evolution.

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: December 8th marks the 46th anniversary of the death of The Beatles' legendary songwriter John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On this day, we remember John Lennon, 46 years since his passing. His timeless music and message of peace continue to resonate globally.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Music icon David Bowie, born on January 8, 1947, would have celebrated his 80th birthday today.

angles.name: Bowie Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the Starman. David Bowie would have been 80 today. His revolutionary artistry and influence on music, fashion, and culture remain unmatched.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, born on January 8, 1935, would have celebrated his 92nd birthday today.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Long live the King! Elvis Presley would have been 92 today. His music continues to define generations and his impact on popular culture is legendary.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin guitarist and songwriter Jimmy Page was born on January 9, 1944.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary Jimmy Page! From The Yardbirds to Led Zeppelin, his iconic guitar riffs changed rock music forever.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: British singer-songwriter Sir Rod Stewart, known for his distinctive raspy voice, was born on January 10, 1945.

angles.name: Rock Icon
angles.copy: Raise a glass to Sir Rod Stewart, celebrating his 82nd birthday today! An incredible career spanning decades, with that unmistakable voice.

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham McPherson, better known as Suggs, the frontman of the iconic band Madness, was born on January 13, 1961.

angles.name: Madness Frontman
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to the one and only Suggs! The charismatic frontman of Madness, bringing us hits and good times for decades.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: English singer Paul Young, known for his soulful voice and 80s hits, was born on January 17, 1956.

angles.name: 80s Soulman
angles.copy: Celebrating the 71st birthday of Paul Young! His incredible voice gave us some of the most memorable tracks of the 80s.

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: Country music legend Dolly Parton, born on January 19, 1946, would have celebrated her 81st birthday today.

angles.name: Dolly Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Dolly Parton, who would have been 81 today. A true icon, songwriter, and philanthropist whose light continues to shine.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow was born on January 20, 1971.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the brilliant Gary Barlow! From Take That to his solo success, a true force in British music.

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean was born on January 21, 1950.

angles.name: R&B Legend
angles.copy: Celebrating the 77th birthday of the smooth and soulful Billy Ocean! His hits still sound as good today as they ever did.

events.title: Rock and Roll Hall of Fame first induction
events.blurb: The first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony was held on January 24, 1989.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: On this day in 1989, rock history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony. Who were your favourite inaugural inductees?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member Mark Owen was born on January 27, 1972.

angles.name: Take That Star
angles.copy: Happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! A vital part of Take That's enduring success and a fantastic solo artist in his own right.

events.title: The Beatles' Rooftop Concert anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles performed their legendary final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London on January 30, 1969.

angles.name: Iconic Gig
angles.copy: 58 years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert. The final public performance from the Fab Four – what a moment!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English musician, singer, songwriter, and record producer Phil Collins was born on January 30, 1951.

angles.name: Music Legend
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! A drumming maestro and a voice that defined decades of hits, both solo and with Genesis.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake was born on January 31, 1981.

angles.name: Pop Superstar
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband sensation to pop superstar, he continues to reign.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Much-loved English actor Sir David Jason, famous for roles in Only Fools and Horses and A Touch of Frost, was born on February 2, 1940.

angles.name: National Treasure
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true national treasure whose iconic characters have brought joy to millions.

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: February 3, 1959, marks 'The Day The Music Died', when Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: Music History
angles.copy: On this day in 1959, the music world lost three stars too soon. Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper on 'The Day The Music Died'.
